description: Submit user feedback on a generated action script — either the whole script (targetType='actionScript', targetId=actionScriptId) or a specific step (targetType='step', targetId=`${actionScriptId}:${stepIndex}` with 0-based stepIndex). Persists the feedback and triggers an async feedback-analysis workflow that may regenerate the script in the cloud. A script generated on the user's machine is never regenerated there, and nothing happens for it until it runs locally: the response's localRegenerationTestCaseIds names the target when it is one, and the entry's outcome names similar test cases once the analysis ends. The response includes the saved feedback, localRegenerationTestCaseIds and, when the analysis workflow was started, a feedbackAnalysisWorkflowRuntimeId for polling.

feedbackText.description: Free-form paragraph describing what went wrong and what the expected behavior should be

projectId.description: Project ID (UUID) the feedback belongs to

target.description: What entity this feedback is about (action script or a specific step)

targetId.description: Target identifier. For 'actionScript' use the actionScriptId; for 'step' use `${actionScriptId}:${stepIndex}` (0-based stepIndex)

targetType.description: Target entity kind: 'actionScript' for whole-script feedback, 'step' for a specific step

name: muggle-remote-user-feedback-create
